sources.snippet: Overview all-MiniLM-L12-v2 is a sentence embedding model developed by sentence-transformers that encodes sentences and short paragraphs into 384-dimensional dense vectors for semantic search, clustering, and similarity tasks. sources.snippet: all-MiniLM-L12-v2 is a sentence embedding model developed by Sentence Transformers and released in February 2023. It is based on the MiniLM architecture with 12 transformer layers, and it maps input text to dense 384-dimensional vector representations.
